77    /**
78     * @return array
79     */
80    public function guessColumnFormatters(\Faker\Generator $generator)
81    {
82        $formatters = [];
83        $nameGuesser = new \Faker\Guesser\Name($generator);
84        $columnTypeGuesser = new ColumnTypeGuesser($generator);
85
86        foreach ($this->class->getFieldNames() as $fieldName) {
87            if ($this->class->isIdentifier($fieldName) || !$this->class->hasField($fieldName)) {
88                continue;
89            }
90
91            $size = $this->class->fieldMappings[$fieldName]['length'] ?? null;
92
93            if ($formatter = $nameGuesser->guessFormat($fieldName, $size)) {
94                $formatters[$fieldName] = $formatter;
95
96                continue;
97            }
98
99            if ($formatter = $columnTypeGuesser->guessFormat($fieldName, $this->class)) {
100                $formatters[$fieldName] = $formatter;
101
102                continue;
103            }
104        }
105
106        foreach ($this->class->getAssociationNames() as $assocName) {
107            if ($this->class->isCollectionValuedAssociation($assocName)) {
108                continue;
109            }
110
111            $relatedClass = $this->class->getAssociationTargetClass($assocName);
112
113            $unique = $optional = false;
114
115            if ($this->class instanceof \Doctrine\ORM\Mapping\ClassMetadata) {
116                $mappings = $this->class->getAssociationMappings();
117
118                foreach ($mappings as $mapping) {
119                    if ($mapping['targetEntity'] == $relatedClass) {
120                        if ($mapping['type'] == \Doctrine\ORM\Mapping\ClassMetadata::ONE_TO_ONE) {
121                            $unique = true;
122                            $optional = $mapping['joinColumns'][0]['nullable'] ?? false;
123
124                            break;
125                        }
126                    }
127                }
128            } elseif ($this->class instanceof \Doctrine\ODM\MongoDB\Mapping\ClassMetadata) {
129                $mappings = $this->class->associationMappings;
130
131                foreach ($mappings as $mapping) {
132                    if ($mapping['targetDocument'] == $relatedClass) {
133                        if ($mapping['type'] == \Doctrine\ODM\MongoDB\Mapping\ClassMetadata::ONE && $mapping['association'] == \Doctrine\ODM\MongoDB\Mapping\ClassMetadata::REFERENCE_ONE) {
134                            $unique = true;
135                            $optional = $mapping['nullable'] ?? false;
136
137                            break;
138                        }
139                    }
140                }
141            }
142
143            $index = 0;
144            $formatters[$assocName] = static function ($inserted) use ($relatedClass, &$index, $unique, $optional, $generator) {
145                if (isset($inserted[$relatedClass])) {
146                    if ($unique) {
147                        $related = null;
148
149                        if (isset($inserted[$relatedClass][$index]) || !$optional) {
150                            $related = $inserted[$relatedClass][$index];
151                        }
152
153                        ++$index;
154
155                        return $related;
156                    }
157
158                    return $generator->randomElement($inserted[$relatedClass]);
159                }
160
161                return null;
162            };
163        }
164
165        return $formatters;
166    }

168    /**
169     * Insert one new record using the Entity class.
170     *
171     * @param bool $generateId
172     *
173     * @return EntityPopulator
174     */
175    public function execute(ObjectManager $manager, $insertedEntities, $generateId = false)
176    {
177        $obj = $this->class->newInstance();
178
179        $this->fillColumns($obj, $insertedEntities);
180        $this->callMethods($obj, $insertedEntities);
181
182        if ($generateId) {
183            $idsName = $this->class->getIdentifier();
184
185            foreach ($idsName as $idName) {
186                $id = $this->generateId($obj, $idName, $manager);
187                $this->class->reflFields[$idName]->setValue($obj, $id);
188            }
189        }
190
191        $manager->persist($obj);
192
193        return $obj;
194    }
195
196    private function fillColumns($obj, $insertedEntities): void
197    {
198        foreach ($this->columnFormatters as $field => $format) {
199            if (null !== $format) {
200                // Add some extended debugging information to any errors thrown by the formatter
201                try {
202                    $value = is_callable($format) ? $format($insertedEntities, $obj) : $format;
203                } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $ex) {
204                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf(
205                        'Failed to generate a value for %s::%s: %s',
206                        get_class($obj),
207                        $field,
208                        $ex->getMessage(),
209                    ));
210                }
211                // Try a standard setter if it's available, otherwise fall back on reflection
212                $setter = sprintf('set%s', ucfirst($field));
213
214                if (is_callable([$obj, $setter])) {
215                    $obj->$setter($value);
216                } else {
217                    $this->class->reflFields[$field]->setValue($obj, $value);
218                }
219            }
220        }
221    }
222
223    private function callMethods($obj, $insertedEntities): void
224    {
225        foreach ($this->getModifiers() as $modifier) {
226            $modifier($obj, $insertedEntities);
227        }
228    }
229
230    /**
231     * @return int
232     */
233    private function generateId($obj, $column, ObjectManager $manager)
234    {
235        $repository = $manager->getRepository(get_class($obj));
236        $result = $repository->createQueryBuilder('e')
237                ->select(sprintf('e.%s', $column))
238                ->getQuery()
239                ->execute();
240        $ids = array_map('current', $result->toArray());
241
242        do {
243            $id = mt_rand();
244        } while (in_array($id, $ids, false));
245
246        return $id;
247    }
248}
